body:
Test-ref push procedure under v6.3 (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, landed 7fa57966 on 2026-10-19; Greg: "tak, Opus moze wypychac"). Integration owner = Termal::Opus2. First use: w-604b, commit c723f2d5, pushed 18:53:20Z.

Steps:
1. Verify the producer's freeze while it still verifies. `target/release/termal.exe review-freeze-check ROOT MANIFEST FINGERPRINT` (manifest usually at .git/worktrees/<root>/engram-review-freeze.json) must exit 0 with stdout exactly the fingerprint.
2. Compute the complete frozen-input tree: copy the root's index (use an ABSOLUTE GIT_INDEX_FILE path, since a relative path under `git -C ROOT` gives the empty tree 4b825dc6), then run write-tree. Confirm 0 unstaged and 0 untracked, or the tree must include untracked files.
3. BEFORE committing, note on the item the tree id beside the fingerprint.
4. `printf '%s\n' FP | git commit-tree TREE -p BASE`. The message is the fingerprint ONLY: no Co-Authored-By trailer, because the repository rule outranks the attribution reminder. Verify tree, single parent and message.
5. `git push origin <commit>:refs/heads/test/<item-shortref>-<fp8>`, then ls-remote. Only the remote-tracking ref appears locally; no local branch.
6. Send the receipt (ref, commit, tree, parent, message, push time) to the coordinator for the runner.
7. Delete with `git push origin --delete <ref>` once the run's evidence is recorded (at the latest when the items close), then ls-remote, and note the push and deletion (commit, tree, fingerprint, times) on the item.
A remote full gate on the ref counts as the landing gate only after its result is imported as a recognized record bound to the tree id, and only for a landing whose master commit has that tree.
